newsitem.title: USA: Cali buys 55 buildings for $900 mln - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Cali buys 55 buildings for $900 mln - WSJ.

text.p: Cali Realty Corp agreed to buy 55 office buildings controlled by New Jersey's Mack family for more than $900 million in cash and securities, plus assumed debt, the Wall Street Journal reported.
The deal, expected to be announced Thursday, makes developer William Mack the largest shareholder in Cali, which will be remaned Mack-Cali Realty Corp, the paper said.
Mack will own about 18.0 percent of Cali after the deal, the paper added.

Under terms of the agreement, Cali will take control of the portfolios of Mack Co in Rochelle, New Jersey, and Dallas-based Patriot American Office Group for $476 million in cash, securities valued at $425 million and the assumption of $302 million in debt, according to the paper.
The move is the latest string of transactions in which private real-estate families have tapped the public markets, the paper said.
